purpose: Distinguish witness multiplicity, parallel retelling, distinct local scenes, and coverage families before permanent narrative identity is assigned.

rules.PNIE-R01: Shared subject alone does not prove scene identity.
rules.PNIE-R02: Cross-source convergence confirms coverage, not identity.
rules.PNIE-R03: A local instance must be bounded before comparison.
rules.PNIE-R06: Permanent IDs require a family verdict and lineage gate.
rules.PNIE-R07: Coverage-only families receive family identity, not narrative identity.
